title.narrative: UNICEF Malaysia has made significant strides in advancing children and youth?s rights to a safe, clean, and sustainable environment. Through strategic advocacy and collaboration with partners, climate policies such as the Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0 development process have been informed by the needs and recommendations of children and youth across Malaysia. Together with partners from government, private sector, CSO and youth-led organisations UNICEF has strengthened the resilience of 17,000 children and young people t o respond to climate change and disasters, to act as agents of change, and to advocate for greater climate and environmental action.
